summaries.title: One Wide Feedforward is All You Need
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **One Wide Feedforward is All** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖模型架构与序列建模（Architecture），并引入 Attention
and the Feed Forward Network (FFN) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Attention captures interdependencies between words regardless of their position, while the FFN non-linearly transforms each input token independently。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this work we explore the role of the FFN, and find that despite taking up a significant fraction of the model's parameters, it is highly redundant。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In this work we explore the role of the FFN, and find that despite taking up a significant fraction of the model's...；Finally we scale this architecture back to its original size by increasing the hidden dimension of the shared FFN,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 34 赞），本工作修正了对 **模型架构与序列建模** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Sequential Dexterity: Chaining Dexterous Policies for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**具身智能与物理AI**（Embodied & VLA）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减、跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Sequential Dexterity** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：We present Sequential Dexterity, a general system based on reinforcement learning (RL) that chains multiple dexterous policies for achieving long-horizon task goals。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Many real-world manipulation tasks consist of a series of subtasks that are significantly different from one another。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The core of the system is a transition feasibility function that progressively finetunes the sub-policies for enhancing chaining success rate, while also enables autonomous...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 4 赞），本工作为突破 **人形控制与真机灵巧操作 (Humanoid & Manip)** 中的「长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
